primary.formula: mean(raw wheel velocity in primary) - mean(raw wheel velocity baseline), each wheel; report L-R
primary.gap_rule_scope: Conservative metric support criterion fixed before new pilot data. Over limit => primary unknown and hold next slot; no interpolation/drop/replacement. Not a physical safety bound or reuse of sim98% gate.
primary.command_gap_scope: Same as existing final-command freshness guard; 100ms limit applies wheel/source support. No actuator timing claim.

review_policy: After the only capture review raw, initialization transitions and operator wheel/body outcome. Complete on reviewed pass; stop/unknown otherwise; no later slots.
allocation_policy: Require active zero command stack and5s fresh scans with <3 static-zone points, no recent monitor STOP, before session allocation. Bounded10s preallocation wait; failure consumes no slot. Once allocated, no retry.
proposed_budget_note: One new verification only; historical V1/V2 remain stopped1/3; no reuse/replacements.
correction: Force Pi gate off, zero, explicit firmware-disable with post-request ACK before2s baseline; reject re-enable during baseline; then require fresh disabled-to-enabled ACK before unchanged source profile. Sequence completion is not physical motion verification.
first_slot_policy: The only slot is functional verification; no extra motion smoke.

scene_readiness.scope: Conservative staticXY readiness while stationary; not safety certification or exact online base-shift count.

scene_supervision.scope: StaticXY scan readiness with declaredTF, unchanged polygon; additional conservative supervision, actual collision monitor unchanged.
scene_supervision.abort: zero/gate disable/motor disable, record failure, no auto resume/retry
scene_supervision.limitations: Not safety certification, exact online count or bounded physical stopping latency. Sparse monitor channel cannot prove absence of pre-existing STOP without current event; fresh scene and unchanged collision monitor remain required.

analysis_support: Missing forward/end anchors in aborted attempts report unknown/partial phases instead of raising StopIteration; normal-run metric unchanged.
root_cause_status: Confirmed helper initialization defect, reproduced by mock. Not proven cause of operator-reported no-motion; bag reported motor rotation and final nonzero in latestv2; flashed binary/motor mode not independently read back.
primary_claim: Wheel report vs physical video; no body/slip claim without independent reference and clock validation.
